source: Normalization also interacts with dimensional truncation. Matryoshka Representation Learning notes that when normalized representations are used, normalization should be handled independently for each nested dimension rather than truncating a normalized full vector and assuming the prefix remains unit length. [15]
zh: 归一化还与维度截断相互作用。俄罗斯套娃表示学习指出，当使用归一化表示时，应针对每个嵌套维度独立处理归一化，而不是截断归一化全向量并假设前缀保持单位长度。 [15]
